entries.title: Job 33:1
segments: ¶Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear mine utterances, and hearken to all my words.

entries.title: Job 33:2
segments: Behold now, I have opened my mouth, my tongue speaketh in my palate,

entries.title: Job 33:3
segments: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart, and my lips shall utter knowledge purely.

entries.title: Job 33:4
segments: The Spirit of *God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

entries.title: Job 33:5
segments: If thou canst, answer me; array [thy words] before me: take thy stand.

entries.title: Job 33:6
segments: Behold, before *God I am as thou; I also am formed out of the clay.

entries.title: Job 33:7
segments: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, nor my burden be heavy upon thee.

entries.title: Job 33:8
segments: ¶Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, and I have heard the voice of [thy] words: --

entries.title: Job 33:9
segments: I am clean without transgression; I am pure, and there is no iniquity in me;

entries.title: Job 33:10
segments: Lo, he findeth occasions of hostility against me, he counteth me for his enemy;

entries.title: Job 33:11
segments: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

entries.title: Job 33:12
segments: Behold, I will answer thee in this, thou art not right; for +God is greater than man.

entries.title: Job 33:13
segments: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.

entries.title: Job 33:14
segments: ¶For *God speaketh once, and twice, --[and man] perceiveth it not--

entries.title: Job 33:15
segments: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

entries.title: Job 33:16
segments: Then he openeth men's ears, and sealeth their instruction,

entries.title: Job 33:17
segments: That he may withdraw man [from his] work, and hide pride from man.

entries.title: Job 33:18
segments: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from passing away by the sword.

entries.title: Job 33:19
segments: ¶He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and with constant strife in his bones;

entries.title: Job 33:20
segments: And his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty food;

entries.title: Job 33:21
segments: His flesh is consumed away from view, and his bones that were not seen stick out;

entries.title: Job 33:22
segments: And his soul draweth near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

entries.title: Job 33:23
segments: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his duty;

entries.title: Job 33:24
segments: Then he will be gracious unto him, and say, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

entries.title: Job 33:25
segments: His flesh shall be fresher than in childhood; he shall return to the days of his youth.

entries.title: Job 33:26
segments: He shall pray unto +God, and he will receive him with favour; and he shall see his face with shoutings, and he will render unto man his righteousness.

entries.title: Job 33:27
segments: He will sing before men, and say, I have sinned, and perverted what was right, and it hath not been requited to me;

entries.title: Job 33:28
segments: He hath delivered my soul from going into the pit, and my life shall see the light.

entries.title: Job 33:29
segments: ¶Lo, all these [things] worketh *God twice, thrice, with man,

entries.title: Job 33:30
segments: To bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

entries.title: Job 33:31
segments: Mark well, Job, hearken unto me; be silent, and I will speak.

entries.title: Job 33:32
segments: If thou hast anything to say, answer me; speak, for I desire to justify thee.

entries.title: Job 33:33
segments: If not, hearken thou unto me; be silent, and I will teach thee wisdom.
